name: Lichen planus pigmentosus
advice: Strict sun protection with a tinted sunscreen (blocks visible light). Stop mustard/amla oil on skin, henna and black hair dye (PPD) and scrubbing. Improvement is slow — months. Tests: LFT, HCV antibody, thyroid if indicated.
